shellCommands.command: node -e "console.log(require('/workspace/node_modules/next/package.json').version)"; echo "=== headers.d.ts ==="; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/request/cookies.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== hdrs ==="; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/request/headers.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30
(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/ && break; sleep 1; done; echo "server up"

cd /tmp
extract() { grep -o '<dd>[^<]*</dd>' | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g' | paste -sd' | ' -; }

echo -n "1. no cookie, no A-L header      -> "; curl -s -H 'Accept-Language;' http://localhost:3111/ --header 'Accept-Language:' | extract
echo -n "2. theme=dark, A-L en-US         -> "; curl -s -b 'theme=dark' -H 'Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9' http://localhost:3111/ | extract
echo -n "3. no cookie, A-L fr weighted    -> "; curl -s -H 'Accept-Language: en;q=0.8,fr-CH,fr;q=0.9,*;q=0.5' http://localhost:3111/ | extract
echo -n "4. theme=sepia, other cookies    -> "; curl -s -b 'sid=abc; theme=sepia; foo=bar' -H 'Accept-Language: de-DE' http://localhost:3111/ | extract
echo -n "5. empty theme cookie            -> "; curl -s -b 'theme=' -H 'Accept-Language: ja' http://localhost:3111/ | extract
echo -n "6. A-L only wildcard             -> "; curl -s -H 'Accept-Language: *' http://localhost:3111/ | extract
echo -n "7. A-L all q=0                   -> "; curl -s -H 'Accept-Language: en;q=0' http://localhost:3111/ | extract
echo -n "8. malformed q value             -> "; curl -s -H 'Accept-Language: es;q=abc,pt;q=0.5' http://localhost:3111/ | extract
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig include ==="; grep -n '"include"' -A1 /workspace/tsconfig.json

git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig include ==="; grep -n '"include"' -A1 /workspace/tsconfig.json; echo "=== server still up? ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 3 http://localhost:3111/ || echo "down"
cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== package.json diff ==="; git diff package.json
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf /workspace/.next /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short
